title: AutoControl Arena: Synthesizing Executable Test Environments for Frontier AI Risk Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2603.07427v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, existing safety evaluations face a fundamental trade-off: manual benchmarks are costly, while LLM-based simulators are scalable but suffer from logic hallucination. We present AutoControl Arena, an automated framework for frontier AI risk evaluation built on the principle of logic-narrative decoupling. By grounding deterministic state in executable code while delegating generative dynamics to LLMs, we mitigate hallucination while maintaining flexibility. translated_title: AutoControl Arena：面向前沿AI风险评估的可执行测试环境自动合成框架
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）演变为自主智能体，现有的安全评估面临一个根本性权衡：人工基准成本高昂，而基于LLM的模拟器虽具备可扩展性，却存在逻辑幻觉问题。我们提出了AutoControl Arena，一个基于“逻辑-叙事解耦”原则构建的前沿AI风险自动评估框架。通过将确定性状态锚定于可执行代码，同时将生成性动态委托给LLM，我们在保持灵活性的同时缓解了幻觉问题。该原则通过一个三智能体框架得以实例化，实现了超过98%的端到端成功率，并在人类偏好上比现有模拟器高出60%。为激发潜在风险，我们在X-Bench（涵盖70个场景、7类风险类别）中改变环境的压力与诱惑水平。对9个前沿模型的评估揭示：（1）对齐幻觉：在压力之下，风险率从21.7%激增至54.5%，且能力更强的模型表现出不成比例的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AutoControl Arena框架，通过“逻辑-叙事解耦”原则将确定性状态交由可执行代码处理、生成性动态交由LLM承担，从而自动合成可执行测试环境以缓解幻觉并高效评估前沿AI风险，同时通过X-Bench揭示了前沿模型在压力下风险率从21.7%激增至54.5%的“对齐幻觉”现象。
en_tdlr: AutoControl Arena synthesizes executable test environments for frontier AI risk evaluation through logic-narrative decoupling—grounding deterministic state in executable code while delegating generative dynamics to LLMs—and reveals an "Alignment Illusion" where model risk rates surge from 21.7% to 54.5% under environmental pressure.
